'''Masda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who claimed to be [[Arden Telowe]]'s long-lost sister.

==Biography==
Some time during the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Masda hired a group of scouts to help her locate Telowe in the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In reality, Masda was Telowe's former wife, and was searching for him to exact a measure of revenge for leaving her. Masda was a native of [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], and claimed that Telowe had left her with a failing business and heavy debts. After the scouts agreed to help her, thinking that she was simply looking for her "brother," Masda hired a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to follow them into the desert, in order to ensure Telowe didn't escape.
